title: An Alternative Approach to the Lexicon of Late Biblical Hebrew-Dataset
descriptions: In 2014 Hurvitz et al. published 'A Concise Lexicon of Late Biblical Hebrew: Linguistic Innovations in the Writings of the Second Temple Period' (Leiden: Brill). In the article 'An Alternative Approach to the Lexicon of Late Biblical Hebrew', we give an alternative, quantitative interpretation of the data in the Lexicon.
